notes: Seed URL http://www.co.cass.tx.us/default.aspx?Cass_County/Elections replaced by https://www.co.cass.tx.us/page/cass.Elections (County Clerk). Older files are linked on newtools.cira.state.tx.us (same CIRA hosting). No Clarity or vendor results site found. Last-Modified headers differ per file and look like real upload times. Two scanned PDFs (2024 unofficial, runoff Rep) were read visually from rendered images. Precinct-by-precinct files are posted days after each election; no election-night precinct numbers found for any of the three. No upload on any election night was found, so confidence stays low. Check 3 pending (wayback-data branch not on origin). Rule 43 applied 2026-10-02 (normalize-1): 2024_general LATER to UNDETERMINED; 2026_primary LATER to UNDETERMINED.
tag_rationale: After Rule 43: 2024_general UNDETERMINED, 2026_primary UNDETERMINED, 2026_runoff LATER. Exactly one election is determined, so the tag is COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS with low confidence.

2024_general.fact: Rule 43: no election-night file survives. Previous: The only unofficial 2024 general file, 'UNOFFICIAL RESULTS NOVEMBER 5, 2024' (unofficial_results.pdf), is a scanned 'Texas Secretary of State Election Unofficial Results Report 2024 NOVEMBER 5TH GENERAL ELECTION CASS County' with county totals only; Last-Modified Wed, 06 Nov 2024 14:48:39 GMT (8:48 AM CST Nov 6). Precinct numbers appear only in 'NOVEMBER 2024 PRECINCT RESULTS', a 'Precinct Results Report Official Results' with 'Run Date 11/15/2024', Last-Modified Tue, 19 Nov 2024 17:11:04 GMT.

2026_primary.fact: Rule 43: no election-night file survives. Previous: 'Unofficial Democratic and Republican Precinct by Precinct Results' is a 'Precinct Results Report Unofficial Results CASS COUNTY, TEXAS PRIMARY ELECTION MARCH 3, 2026' with 'Run Time 8:04 AM Run Date 03/06/2026', Last-Modified Fri, 06 Mar 2026 15:38:35 GMT (9:38 AM CST Mar 6), three days after election night. No other unofficial primary results file is on the page.

2026_runoff.fact: 'PRIMARY RUNOFF ELECTION- Republican' (runoffrep.pdf, scanned) is a county-total 'Unofficial Results' summary with printed 'Run Time 8:09 PM Run Date 05/26/2026' (as read from the scan), Last-Modified Wed, 27 May 2026 19:57:01 GMT (2:57 PM CDT May 27). No per-precinct runoff results file is posted on the page.
